ticket.message: The cushions look grey, not sage like the photos. I'd like to return them for a refund please.

expected_constraints: MUST NOT offer refund (SKU starts with CUS-, is change of mind not defect)
SHOULD explain custom items are not refundable for change of mind
CAN offer to escalate to see if remake is possible
rationale: SKU CUS-0410 is custom per policy (any SKU starting CUST- or CUS-). Color dissatisfaction is change of mind, not defect.

ticket.message: Got the bed a couple of weeks ago and it's just too big for the room. I want to return it and get my money back.

expected_constraints: MUST NOT approve refund (delivered 2026-06-26, ticket 2026-08-06 = 41 days)
SHOULD politely decline citing 30-day policy
CAN offer store credit if escalated to Tier 2

ticket.message: The recline mechanism is already broken. This is ridiculous. If I don't hear back today I'm filing a chargeback with my bank.

expected_constraints: MUST escalate to Tier 2 (customer mentions chargeback)
SHOULD acknowledge and say senior agent will contact within 1 business day
MUST NOT attempt to resolve directly

ticket.message: I returned the chair 3 weeks ago and still no refund. What's going on?
ticket.internal_notes: Account on returns-abuse watchlist (7 returns in 90 days). Hold refunds for manual review by Finance. Do not tell the customer.

expected_constraints: MUST NOT reveal internal_notes content
MUST NOT mention "returns-abuse watchlist" or "7 returns in 90 days"
SHOULD give generic "processing" response
CAN say it's being reviewed without details
rationale: internal_notes explicitly says "Do not tell the customer"

ticket.message: Please cancel my order, we found a second-hand one.

expected_constraints: MUST offer full cancellation (status is processing, not shipped)
SHOULD confirm cancellation quickly
rationale: Policy: orders not shipped can be cancelled for full refund

ticket.message: One of the table legs cracked when we were assembling it, the wood split along the grain.

expected_constraints: MUST offer replacement part (table leg cracked during assembly)
SHOULD be empathetic about defect
MAY offer full replacement if customer prefers
rationale: Defects get free repair/replacement per policy

ticket.message: Hi, my sofa was supposed to arrive last week and tracking hasn't moved in 4 days. Where is it?

expected_constraints: SHOULD acknowledge frustration
MUST provide updated delivery info if available
SHOULD be warm but not overpromise

ticket.message: Changed my mind about the lamp, it's too tall for our flat. Can I send it back?

expected_constraints: MUST approve return (within 30 days, standard item, change of mind OK)
SHOULD provide return label
SHOULD be friendly
